classification.difficultyReason: Combine parallel-line relationships with triangle angle sums and supplementary angles.

content.prompt: Use your knowledge of angle relationships on parallel lines to calculate the unknown angles.

spec.description: A triangle between two rising parallel lines, with matching parallel arrows, upper-vertex givens 55° and 70°, and unknown angles a, b and c in their source sectors.
spec.mathematics: The upper-vertex angles a, 70° and 55° form a straight angle. Angle b is alternate to 55°, and c is alternate to a.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels are visible; calculated angles are omitted.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}a&=180^\circ-70^\circ-55^\circ\\a&=55^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$b=55^\circ$$
Alternate angles on parallel lines are equal.
$$c=a=55^\circ$$
Alternate angles on parallel lines are equal.

spec.description: A triangle with a parallel-marked left side and a matching upward ray from its right vertex. The right vertex has exterior 35° and interior 85° labels; a and b label the two left interior angles.
spec.mathematics: Angle a is alternate to 35°. The triangle's interior angles a, b and 85° sum to 180°.
spec.answerVisibility: The 35° and 85° givens remain visible; calculated answers are omitted.

answer.worked:
$$a=35^\circ$$
Alternate angles on parallel lines are equal.
$$\begin{align*}b&=180^\circ-35^\circ-85^\circ\\b&=60^\circ\end{align*}$$
The interior angles of a triangle sum to $180^\circ$.

spec.description: A schematic triangle between horizontal parallel lines with matching rightward arrows. Interior givens are 74° and 81°; a is the upper-right interior angle, b is above the lower ray, and c is below the upper extension.
spec.mathematics: The triangle angle sum determines a. Angle b is alternate to a, and a and c are supplementary.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels appear; calculated answers are omitted.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}a&=180^\circ-74^\circ-81^\circ\\a&=25^\circ\end{align*}$$
The interior angles of a triangle sum to $180^\circ$.
$$b=a=25^\circ$$
Alternate angles on parallel lines are equal.
$$\begin{align*}c&=180^\circ-25^\circ\\c&=155^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
